title: Shell mega menu and account polish
summary: The top menu shows section dropdowns after the logo, with a More sections overflow when space is tight. Admins switch Staff and Admin from the account menu, panels are easier to read, and pages use more of the screen width.

added: Top-level menu sections after the logo open compact dropdown lists.
When there is not enough room, overflowed sections appear under More sections.
changed: Home goes straight to the dashboard.
Admins open Staff panel or Admin panel from the account menu instead of a switch beside the logo.
Account and menu panels use a solid background so the text is easier to read.
Page content uses 95% of the screen width.
removed: The hamburger Open menu button and the side drawer that copied the old left menu.
accessibility: Keyboard users open and close section dropdowns and the account menu with Enter, Space and Escape.

internal_notes: Epic #375. Shipped #376 always-visible menus; #377 Staff/Admin in account menu; #378 opaque panels and 95% content width; #383 Home link and single-row top nav; #385 compact dropdowns and More sections overflow.
